heading.en: Plus and minus, held close together

hook.en: A water molecule is neutral, yet it turns to line up in an electric field. Its positive and negative charge centres are slightly apart: it is a dipole. Microwave ovens heat food by twisting these dipoles back and forth.
hook.kn: ನೀರಿನ ಅಣು ತಟಸ್ಥವಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ಸಾಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣ ಆವೇಶ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ: ಅದು ಒಂದು ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ.

objectives.en: Define dipole moment and find the field on the axis and the equatorial line.
Find the torque on a dipole in a uniform field.

narration.en: A water molecule is neutral, yet it turns to line up in an electric field. Its positive and negative charge centres are slightly apart: it is a dipole. Microwave ovens heat food by twisting these dipoles back and forth.
narration.kn: ನೀರಿನ ಅಣು ತಟಸ್ಥವಾಗಿದ್ದರೂ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗಿ ಸಾಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಧನ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣ ಆವೇಶ ಕೇಂದ್ರಗಳು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ: ಅದು ಒಂದು ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ.

title.en: Dipole moment and the dipole field

body.en: An electric dipole is a pair of equal and opposite charges ±q separated by a distance 2a. Its dipole moment $\vec p$ has magnitude $q\times2a$ and points from −q to +q (unit C m). Far from the dipole (r ≫ a) the field on the axis is $2kp/r^3$ along $\vec p$, and on the equatorial line it is $kp/r^3$ opposite to $\vec p$. A dipole's field falls as 1/r³, faster than a point charge's 1/r².
body.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಎಂದರೆ 2a ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ +q ಮತ್ತು −q. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಭ್ರಾಮಕ p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³, ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³.

points.en: Equatorial: E = kp/r³ opposite to p

narration.en: A dipole is plus q and minus q separated by 2a. Its moment p equals q times 2a and points from the negative to the positive charge. Far away, the axial field is 2kp by r cubed and the equatorial field is kp by r cubed.
narration.kn: ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಎಂದರೆ 2a ಅಂತರದಲ್ಲಿರುವ +q ಮತ್ತು −q. ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವ ಭ್ರಾಮಕ p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³, ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³.

title.en: Dipole in a uniform external field

body.en: In a uniform field the forces +qE and −qE are equal and opposite, so the net force is zero. But they act at different points and form a couple of torque $\tau = pE\sin\theta$, which turns $\vec p$ towards $\vec E$. θ = 0° is stable equilibrium and θ = 180° is unstable. In a non-uniform field there is also a net force.
body.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = pE sinθ ಅದನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: τ = pE sin θ, maximum at 90°

narration.en: In a uniform field a dipole feels no net force, but it feels a torque p E sin theta that turns it to line up with the field. Aligned is stable; opposite is unstable.
narration.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ದ್ವಿಧ್ರುವದ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಆದರೆ ಟಾರ್ಕ್ τ = pE sinθ ಅದನ್ನು ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದ ದಿಕ್ಕಿಗೆ ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: A dipole has charges ±2 nC separated by 4 mm. Find its dipole moment and the torque on it in a uniform field of 5 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ at 30° to the field.

answer.en: p = 8 × 10⁻¹² C m; τ = 2 × 10⁻⁷ N m

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A dipole has charges ±2 nC separated by 4 mm. Find its dipole moment and the torque on it in a uniform field of 5 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹ at 30° to the field.

problem.en: A short dipole has p = 4 × 10⁻⁹ C m. Find the field 10 cm away on its axis and on its equatorial line.

steps.en: Equatorial: half of this, 3.6 × 10⁴ N C⁻¹.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A short dipole has p = 4 × 10⁻⁹ C m. Find the field 10 cm away on its axis and on its equatorial line.

body.en: At the same large distance, a short dipole's field on its axis is exactly twice its field on the equatorial line, and both fall as 1/r³: double r, and the field becomes one-eighth.

narration.en: Axial is twice equatorial. At the same large distance, a short dipole's field on its axis is exactly twice its field on the equatorial line, and both fall as 1/r³: double r, and the field becomes one-eighth.

points.en: p = q × 2a, from −q to +q; unit C m.
points.kn: p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ; ಏಕಮಾನ C m.

points.en: In a uniform field: zero net force, torque pE sin θ.
points.kn: ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಟಾರ್ಕ್ pE sinθ.

homework.en: Find the torque on a dipole of moment 5 × 10⁻⁹ C m at 60° to a field of 2 × 10⁵ N C⁻¹.

narration.en: Recap. p = q × 2a, from −q to +q; unit C m. Axial field 2kp/r³; equatorial field kp/r³. In a uniform field: zero net force, torque pE sin θ.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. p = q × 2a, −q ಇಂದ +q ಕಡೆಗೆ; ಏಕಮಾನ C m. ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ 2kp/r³; ಸಮಭಾಜಕ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ kp/r³. ಏಕರೂಪ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ: ಒಟ್ಟು ಬಲ ಶೂನ್ಯ, ಟಾರ್ಕ್ pE sinθ.
